name: Scenario A: Golden Path
description: Highland Timber Supplies submits a Sitka Spruce batch for FSC certification. Auditor approves with a high sustainability score; ForestProductDPPCredential is issued.

1.supportingEvidence: FSC chain-of-custody cert FSC-COC-2024-HTS, harvest licence FCS-HL-26-0418, supplier's last annual audit (Q1 2026).

2.auditFindings: Chain of custody verified end-to-end. Glen Affric compartment 24 holds active FSC certification (cert FSC-FM-2023-0091). No treatment chemicals applied. Independently measured embodied carbon at 36.4 kg CO2e/m^3, marginally below supplier declaration. Mill audit Q1 2026 confirmed scope and segregation controls.
